source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 292 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 292 was established by Ordinance No. 19898, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 23, 1988. Ordinance No. 19898 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 292 is established on property generally bounded by the northeast line of Peavy Road, the southwest line of Naylor Street, and the northwest line of Hermosa Drive. The size of PD 292 is approximately 6,234 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development of the Property must comply with the site plan (Exhibit 292A). (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Use
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.105. USE.

Use of the Property is limited to a child-care facility and all other uses permitted in a TH-3(A) district. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.106. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

Maximum floor area on the Property is 2,100 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.107. PARKING.

A minimum of four parking spaces for the child-care facility must be provided by private license in the right-of-way for Naylor Street adjacent to the site as shown on the site plan. If the private license with the city expires, or if the parking is not provided as shown on the site plan, parking for the use must be provided as required in Chapter 51A. All other permitted uses must provide parking as required in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Indoor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.108. INDOOR AREA.

A minimum of 50 square feet of indoor area must be provided for each child in attendance at the child-care facility. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Outdoor Play Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.109. OUTDOOR PLAY AREA.

A minimum of 100 square feet of outdoor play area must be provided for each child in the play area at one time. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.110. FENCING.

The outdoor play area must be totally enclosed with a minimum four-foot-high fence as shown on the site plan. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Access From Naylor
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.111. ACCESS FROM NAYLOR.

Unobstructed pedestrian access must be provided to the Property from Naylor Street within 30 days of March 23, 1988. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.112. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the non-business standards of Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.113. MAINTENANCE.

The entire premise must be maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.114. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

The owner must comply with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.115. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-292.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 292 is located on Zoning Map No. H-10. (Ord. Nos. 19898; 25711)
